mechanism.owner: Apptainer built-in fuseapps image driver; not fuse2fs itself or Slurm.
mechanism.wait_limit: Local variable maxTime := 10 * time.Second in v1.4.4 imagedriver.go:387.
mechanism.poll: Each iteration sleeps 25ms, then rereads /proc/self/mountinfo and matches entry.Point exactly to params.Target. The counter measures requested sleep intervals; mountinfo processing can add wall time.
mechanism.two_second_threshold: infoTime := 2 * time.Second only selects a slow-mount informational message after success.
mechanism.override: No per-process environment variable, CLI flag or apptainer.conf setting controls this local timeout in v1.4.4. Config binary path only selects a helper; image driver selects a registered replacement plugin, not a wait override.
mechanism.ext3_helper_arguments: The ext3 branch invokes fuse2fs with -f -o allow_other plus applicable ro/fakeroot options, source and target. It does not provide a timeout option to the helper.
mechanism.timeout_cleanup: At timeout, stop(target,true) sends SIGTERM, after a one-second wait sends SIGKILL if necessary, and waits/reaps the helper. Stopping a writable image helper does not prove no filesystem writes occurred.
mechanism.what_the_log_proves: The required target mountpoint was not observed within the fixed wait window. It does not identify whether helper startup, backing-file I/O, scheduling or another mount step caused the delay.

minimal_next_step.action: One bounded fresh application retry from the same sealed dependency checkpoint using the frozen c3b65b9 controller and identical source/recipe/partition identity.
minimal_next_step.entry: software_controller.py submit ... --dependencies-run 39078998459-1-release-dsprhbm-2026-10-17-67b5da876dd6-dependencies with a fresh run_id and required staged inputs.
minimal_next_step.why_supported: cp2k_dependency_stage.clone validates the completed sealed source, creates a new target, verifies hashes, performs clone-only workdir cleanup and fsck, and preserves dependency receipts; the application build then runs normally.
minimal_next_step.why_not_resume_run: --resume-run selects metadata/repack, not compilation. This failure occurred before the build entrypoint, so there is no completed application installation to repack.
minimal_next_step.preservation: Retain the failed application run and overlay unchanged. Do not mount it to retry or rewrite its request/job identifiers. Do not rerun or unseal successful dependencies.
minimal_next_step.reliability_boundary: A fresh retry safely isolates state and avoids rebuilding dependencies; success is not guaranteed because the delay cause is unknown. Clone preparation already reads and hashes the full target, so an extra warm-up read has no established benefit.
minimal_next_step.repeat_failure: If the same startup timeout recurs, stop repeated production retries and collect an independently recorded debug startup diagnosis under a fresh clone. Extending external timeouts or helper options does not change the fixed parent wait.
minimal_next_step.recipe_change_needed_for_longer_wait: Changing Apptainer or replacing the image-driver implementation requires separately validated provenance; it is not a hidden environment-only workaround for this frozen workflow.
